Steel Water Towers are elevated water storage structures made primarily from
welded or bolted steel components, designed to supply water at a constant
pressure and volume to nearby areas. These towers are widely
used across both rural and urban settings due to
their cost-effectiveness, ease of construction, and structural flexibility.
Lower initial cost compared to concrete towers
Modular and scalable – easily expanded or
Ideal for rural and industrial applications
Fire protection systems in industrial plants
Concrete Water Towers are robust, elevated
structures constructed using reinforced concrete to
store and distribute water at a steady pressure.
These towers are known for their durability, minimal
them ideal for long-term municipal and institutional
